name: Boreal
services: Concept · Naming · Logo · Branding · Packaging · 3D Modeling · Animation
desc: I made Boreal's ski bindings brutalist on purpose. The angular, solid shape reads as safe, strong, and reliable, gear that's built to protect you and take a beating.

sections.body: I set out to build ski bindings with GPS, sensors, and anti-theft built in, so skiers can track their runs and never worry about their gear getting lifted off the rack.

sections.hd: Creative Strategy: For the Serious Skier
sections.body: "These bindings aren't for the average jerry." I made them for skiers who actually compete and want to get better, so the tech and the look both had to feel as serious as they are.
The app tracks every run in real time, speed, distance, the numbers that matter, and layers on anti-theft alerts and daily challenges to keep you coming back.
Everything from the first rough sketches to the final 3D renders.

name: Nestquest
services: Concept · Product Design · App Design · Card Game Design · Branding
desc: I built Nestquest to pull kids off endless screen time and back outside. They point image-recognition binoculars at a bird and get the species right away, so exploring nature actually feels fun and hands-on, and they learn something too.

sections.body: Kids spend way too much time on screens. I wanted to flip technology into a reason to get outside instead of a reason to stay in.

sections.hd: Creative Strategy: New Tech, Familiar Feel
sections.body: I paired new tech with something kids already love, collecting trading cards, and turned birdwatching into a game they'd actually compete over and trade.

sections.hd: The Card Game: Collect, Trade, Compete
sections.body: Collect the birds you spot, trade them with friends, and race to finish the set. That's the reason to keep heading outside.
Bright, playful campaign visuals built to catch kids' attention and get them curious enough to go find the real thing.

name: Peak
services: Concept · Naming · Logo · Branding · Packaging · 3D Modeling · Website Design
desc: Peak is Lion's Mane in a sublingual troche. It melts under your tongue and goes straight into your bloodstream, skipping the trip through your gut, so you feel it in hours instead of weeks.

sections.body: Pills and tablets have to work their way through your gut first. Peak melts under your tongue and skips all that, so it kicks in far faster.
I aimed it at busy, driven people who care about getting more done, and made it look nothing like the soft, earthy wellness brands sitting next to it on the shelf.
Gold, deep green, maroon, and navy, a palette that reads as money and ambition, not another beige health-store box.
The campaign leans on lightbulbs and money, bright ideas and the payoff, and talks straight to people chasing sharper focus.

name: Cognis
services: Concept · AI Art · Storytelling · Print Design · Riso Printing
desc: At the start of 2023, with tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney on the rise, I saw my chance to finally make a comic book, a long time dream of mine.

sections.body: I spent weeks generating thousands of images, piecing them into one story, and using Photoshop to keep the characters consistent. By the end I had a full AI-assisted visual story.
I chose to Riso print this comic as a playful contrast between old and new technology. Since Cognis explores the future and AI, it felt right to use a retro printing aesthetic like Riso.
From the AI-generated concepts through the editing and the Riso printing, the whole thing sits right between brand-new tech and old-school print.

name: Pawlish
services: Concept · Naming · Logo · Branding · Packaging · 3D Modeling · Advertising
desc: Pawlish is a nail polish for dogs, with a rubbery finish that adds grip. It keeps them from sliding on hard floors, and keeps their claws from scratching up the wood.

sections.body: Dogs slip and hurt themselves on hardwood and tile. Pawlish is a nail polish with a rubbery finish that gives them grip, and keeps their claws from scratching up your floors.

Looking at what actually sells in big pet stores, around 80% of buyers reach for packaging with a realistic dog on it. So mine leads with exactly that, a dog leaning over a clear window that shows off the painted nails.
Three shades: Jungle Glow (green) for the natural formula, Azure Dream (blue) for peace of mind, and Pinkalicious (pink) for the dogs that like to stand out.
Three ads, one for each thing that matters: it's water-resistant, it actually grips, and it goes on without a fight.

name: Voiage
services: Concept · UI/UX Design · Branding · Web Design
desc: I used blockchain to make charitable giving fully transparent. Every donation is tracked end to end, so you can see exactly where your money goes.

sections.body: Most charitable giving is a black box, you donate and just hope it lands where it should. Voiage records every donation on-chain so you can actually follow it the whole way.

I focused on transparency over the technical details of blockchain. The website looks like any other charitable site at first, but once you make a donation, you get access to a dashboard that shows exactly where your money is going.
Each ad used a see-through bus stop shelter, the whole thing out in the open, nothing hidden. Same idea as the ledger.

name: Mirage
services: Concept · Branding · Art Direction · 3D Modeling · Animation · Advertising
desc: Mirage is a virtual tribute to hip-hop artists whose lives were cut short by addiction. I borrowed the format of a Fortnite-style concert and filled it with the raw energy of live hip-hop, all pointed at a real cause. Every dollar goes straight to addiction recovery organizations.

sections.body: It pairs a VR concert experience with real money going to addiction recovery.
I leaned on reflections, glare, and clashing color to play on the idea of a mirage, there and not there, and on life, death, and what comes after, while celebrating the artists themselves.
The campaign pushed one idea: you can be at Mirage from anywhere, even your living room.

name: OXA
services: Concept · Industrial Design · 3D Printing · Branding · Advertising
desc: OXA is a 3D printed air detoxifier I modeled on Favia coral, whose intricate, porous structure traps sediment and supports filter feeders. It blends into its surroundings, sits anywhere without electricity, and filters through an activated carbon based filament.

sections.body: Most air purifiers are bulky, loud, and have to be plugged in. OXA needs none of that, it blends into the room, runs on no power, and filters through an activated-carbon filament.
The shape comes straight from Favia coral, whose porous structure naturally traps and filters what's around it. Felt right to borrow from something that already does the job.
The campaign put live air-quality meters on bus stop ads, so you could see exactly how dirty the air was, then what it looked like with OXA in the room.

name: Sessio
services: Concept · 3D Modeling · Character Design · Branding · Advertising
desc: I wanted to push the boundaries of skateboarding and make Sessio feel like a whole new world, kind of like Disney. I modeled a frog, named Sevvy, to be the mascot of Sessio. Sevvy represents that playful, rebellious spirit that skateboarding is all about.

sections.body: Most skateparks feel the same after a while. I built Sessio around world wonders and places you're not supposed to skate, for people who want a session to feel like an adventure.
Sevvy the frog is the mascot, all the playful, rule-breaking energy skating runs on. The whole world mixes a sense of wonder with a little bit of forbidden.
The campaign follows Sevvy around the world, skating famous off-limits spots dressed up like theme-park rides, big, bold, and a little unreal.
